reserves.name: AUD cash in the AUDF reserve bank account

sources.label: MVAB Assurance AUDF Reserves Report - December 2025

reserveReview.rationale: MVAB Assurance audited Forte Securities Australia's AUDF reserve bank account as a single AUD cash balance of AUD 4,132,465.51 against AUD 4,125,000 of issued AUDF at 31 December 2025. The report establishes a complete 100% bank-deposit composition; it does not name the bank or disclose account-level terms.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: MVAB independent audit of the AUDF reserve bank-account cash balance
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reserve asset class is identified as an AUD bank-account cash balance. The bank identity, provider concentration, and account terms remain undisclosed custody details.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The audited report identifies one segregated, unencumbered AUDF reserve bank account but does not name the bank, establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, or state whether the cash may be rehypothecated.
